profile.name: Dr. Kishwar Shah
profile.heroTitle: A little understanding. A healthier tomorrow.
profile.heroDescription: Bringing together a background in homoeopathy, hands-on clinical experience, and a growing perspective in public health.
profile.aboutText: I’m Dr. Kishwar Shah, a BHMS graduate currently pursuing a Master of Public Health at Savitribai Phule Pune University. My experience spans hospital care, the municipal COVID-19 response, and independent practice in Manmad.
profile.aboutSecondary: Across these settings, my work has included patient assessment, health education, follow-up, and treatment adherence. Today, I’m continuing that learning through public health studies in Pune.
profile.practiceNotice: My independent practice is currently paused while I pursue my Master of Public Health.
